title: What did they do?
description: A bilingual lesson built around eight past-tense illustrations (shaved/cut, took/ate, gave/drunk, met/greeted, went/arrived, worked, enjoyed, swam) practising the 'What did they do?' question with irregular verbs, plus a word table for making eight sentences. Includes textbook written exercises on forming adverbs and writing sentences from the table, a workbook structure exercise on irregular past forms, and grammar on alternative 'or' questions and sentence-making. 以8幅不规则动词过去时插图（刮胡子/割伤、拿/吃、给/喝、遇见/问候、走/到达、工作、享受、游泳）为主的双语课，练习不规则动词一般过去时的「他们干了什么？」问句，并配合词表造句。配合教材副词构词与词表造句的书面练习、教材不规则动词过去式结构练习，以及「or」选择问句和仿照例句造句的语法练习。
answer_note: Textbook written-exercise A (complete the sentences with adverbs) item Example is a printed example; items 1-5 follow the printed example pattern (adjective → adverb) and the given cues and are labelled suggested. Textbook written-exercise B (write eight sentences from the table) the printed example 'He read the phrase slowly.' is not editable; items 1-8 follow the table and are labelled suggested. Workbook A (structure) part 1 verb table: be-was and cut-cut are printed examples; the remaining 12 blanks and the 15 fill-in-the-sentence items are taken from the supplied Lesson 74 key (img/key-072-075.jpg). Workbook B (situation) answer is taken from the supplied Lesson 74 key (img/key-072-075.jpg). Grammar I (answer the questions) item 1 is a printed example; items 2-8 are taken from the supplied Lesson 74 grammar key (PDF viewer page 505). Grammar II (make sentences) item 1 is a printed example; items 2-8 are taken from the supplied Lesson 74 grammar key (PDF viewer page 505). No external sources were used.

lesson.text:
Listen and answer the questions.
听录音并回答问题。

What did they do? 他们干了什么？
lesson.translation: Listen and answer the questions. What did they do?

lesson.text: He shaved hurriedly this morning and cut himself badly.
lesson.translation: 他今天早上匆匆忙忙地刮了胡子，把自己割伤得很厉害。

lesson.text: He took a cake and ate it quickly.
lesson.translation: 他拿了一块蛋糕，很快就把它吃了。

lesson.text: I gave him a glass of water and he drank it thirstily.
lesson.translation: 我给他一杯水，他渴得很，很快就喝光了。

lesson.text: I met her in the street the day before yesterday and she greeted me warmly.
lesson.translation: 前天我在街上遇见她，她热情地向我打招呼。

lesson.text: The bus went slowly yesterday afternoon and we arrived home late.
lesson.translation: 昨天下午公共汽车走得很慢，我们到家很晚。

lesson.text: They worked very hard this morning.
lesson.translation: 他们今天上午工作得非常努力。

lesson.text: We enjoyed ourselves very much last night.
lesson.translation: 我们昨天晚上玩得很高兴。

lesson.text: He swam very well this afternoon.
lesson.translation: 他今天下午游泳游得很好。

lesson.title: Written exercises A Look at this. 注意下面的词。
lesson.instruction: Look at this: quick — quickly; thirsty — thirstily; careful — carefully. Complete these sentences. 模仿例句完成以下句子。
lesson.translation: Complete each sentence with the adverb form of the adjective in brackets, following the printed example.
lesson.context: Item Example (She smiled ____. (pleasant) → She smiled pleasantly.) is a printed example and is not editable. Items 1-5 follow the same adjective → adverb pattern.

lesson.title: Written exercises B Look at this table. 注意下表。
lesson.instruction: Look at this table. Now write eight sentences. 模仿下面的例句，从上面的表格中选出恰当的词和词组，写出8句话。
lesson.translation: Using the words in the table, write eight sentences in the simple past, following the printed example 'He read the phrase slowly.'
lesson.context: Word table: subjects (He, She, We, The bus); verbs (does not know, read, smiled, went, shaved, drank, greeted, worked, enjoyed ourselves); objects (a glass of water, the phrase, me, London); adverbs (very hard, hurriedly, slowly, very well, thirstily, warmly, pleasantly, very much). The printed example 'He read the phrase slowly.' is not editable.

questions.answer: She shaved herself hurriedly this morning.
We drank a glass of water thirstily.
The bus went to London slowly yesterday.
He greeted me warmly in the street.
She worked very hard this morning.
We enjoyed ourselves very much last night.
She read the phrase very slowly.

practice.title: A Structure — past with irregular verbs
practice.instruction: Look at these irregular verbs and write in the simple past forms. 写出以下不规则动词的过去式。
practice.translation: Write the simple past form of each irregular verb in the table, following the printed examples (be—was, cut—cut).
practice.context: be—was and cut—cut are printed examples and are not editable. The remaining 12 verbs (find, meet, speak, give, read, swim, do, go, say, take, drink, lose, see, understand) are taken from the supplied Lesson 74 key (img/key-072-075.jpg).

practice.title: A Structure — write in the simple past of the irregular verbs in these sentences.
practice.instruction: Write in the simple past of the irregular verbs in these sentences. 用不规则动词的过去式填空。
practice.translation: Fill in each blank with the simple past form of the verb in brackets.
practice.context: Answers are taken from the supplied Lesson 74 key (img/key-072-075.jpg).

questions.prompt: The man ______ (speak) very slowly, but I didn't understand him.
The tourist ______ (lose) his way in Hong Kong.
My friends ______ (meet) me at the railway station.
Jill's father ______ (give) her the key to the front door.
Mrs. Mills ______ (be) in London last week.
The men ______ (drink) their tea very quickly.
We ______ (see) our friends at the bus stop.
The students ______ (understand) me because I spoke very slowly and carefully.
The boy ______ (find) some money and ______ (take) it to his teacher.
That man ______ (do) a very good job for us.
The girl ______ (cut) her leg very badly.
Did she speak to you? – Yes, she ______ (say) 'Hello'.

practice.title: B Situation
practice.instruction: Read this situation. What do you say? 根据以下情景写出你可能会说的话。
practice.translation: You are a tourist in London; you want to find Oxford Street; you ask a woman. Write what you say.
practice.context: Answer is taken from the supplied Lesson 74 key (img/key-072-075.jpg).

questions.prompt: You are a tourist in London. You want to find Oxford Street. You ask a woman. What do you say?
questions.answer: Excuse me. Can you tell me the way to Oxford Street, please?

grammar.source: ../pdf/新概念英语语法练习1_按课程索引.pdf#page=227
grammar.title: I. Answer the questions, using the cues given according to the example. 仿照例句用所给的词回答下列问题。
grammar.instruction: Answer the questions, using the cues given according to the example. 仿照例句用所给的词回答下列问题。
grammar.translation: Answer each alternative 'Did ... or ...?' question using the given cue, following the printed example.
grammar.key_source: ../pdf/新概念英语语法练习1_按课程索引.pdf#page=505
grammar.context: Item 1 is a printed example and is not editable. Items 2-8 are taken from the supplied Lesson 74 grammar key (PDF viewer page 505).

questions.prompt: Did Jane drink coffee or tea last night? (tea)
questions.answer: She drank tea. She didn't drink coffee.

questions.prompt: Did you understand the man or the woman? (woman)
questions.answer: I understood the woman. I didn't understand the man.

questions.prompt: Did she wash the cups or the glasses yesterday? (glasses)
questions.answer: She washed the glasses. She didn't wash the cups.

questions.prompt: Did you eat beef or lamb the day before yesterday? (beef)
questions.answer: I ate beef. I didn't eat lamb.

questions.prompt: Did he give you a tie or a watch last Wednesday? (tie)
questions.answer: He gave me a tie. He didn't give me a watch.

questions.prompt: Did you meet an Italian tourist or a Spanish tourist last week? (Spanish)
questions.answer: I met a Spanish tourist. I didn't meet an Italian tourist.

questions.prompt: Did they do their homework at school or at home yesterday? (at home)
questions.answer: They did their homework at home. They didn't do it at school.

questions.prompt: Did he go to work by bus or by car yesterday morning? (by car)
questions.answer: He went to work by car. He didn't go to work by bus.

grammar.source: ../pdf/新概念英语语法练习1_按课程索引.pdf#page=228
grammar.title: II. Make sentences, using the cues given according to the example. 仿照例句用所给的词造句。
grammar.instruction: Make sentences, using the cues given according to the example. 仿照例句用所给的词造句。
grammar.translation: Make a simple-past sentence using the given cues, following the printed example.
grammar.key_source: ../pdf/新概念英语语法练习1_按课程索引.pdf#page=505
grammar.context: Item 1 is a printed example and is not editable. Items 2-8 are taken from the supplied Lesson 74 grammar key (PDF viewer page 505).

questions.answer: Dave studied English very hard last night.

questions.prompt: the boys and girls/enjoy themselves/very much/last weekend
questions.answer: The boys and girls enjoyed themselves very much last weekend.
Mrs. Mills washed the dishes carefully yesterday evening.

questions.prompt: we/meet Mary/in the street/this morning/greet her warmly
questions.answer: We met Mary in the street this morning and greeted her warmly.

questions.prompt: Tim/run quickly/catch the school bus/yesterday morning
questions.answer: Tim ran quickly and caught the school bus yesterday morning.

questions.prompt: they/walk slowly/to the park/last Saturday evening
questions.answer: They walked slowly to the park last Saturday evening.

questions.prompt: Jack's boss/speak to him angrily/last week
questions.answer: Jack's boss spoke to him angrily last week.
The students worked very well last year.
